title: D.White Makes Impressive Return With “8 Ball”
htmlContent:
D.White, the talented hip-hop recording artist and writer hailing from Columbus, Ohio, has just released his brand-new single, "8 Ball". This introspective and powerful track showcases D.White's poetic finesse and rap prowess, delivering a message of triumph and resilience amidst life's challenges.

Having cultivated his skills in the underground hip-hop scene for nearly a decade, D.White now takes centre stage with "8 Ball", following the success of his previous single, "Feeling Super", which received acclaim upon its release in April.

D.White's journey as an artist has been profoundly influenced by his personal experiences, including two challenging episodes of homelessness. These hardships served as a driving force behind his creative pursuits, leading him to find solace and expression through music and poetry. His debut poetry book, I Made A Place For You, stands as a testament to the healing power of art and its ability to mend a fractured identity.

Speaking about his latest single, D.White shares, “‘8 Ball’ comes with an air of overcoming, optimism and introspection that reflects my current place in life. I wanted to give fans a glimpse into my backstory, peel back a layer on the sound we are developing in the studio and show lyrical versatility with this one. For me, this is a ‘bounce back’ song that tells the story of starting with little to nothing and never yielding to the insecurities that accompany hardships in life. ‘8 Ball’ is a victory over insecurity, worry and fear of becoming who I am destined to be.”

"8 Ball" takes listeners on a compelling journey through D.White's personal growth and transformation. The song's magnetic beats and thought-provoking lyrics create an immersive soundscape that will resonate with audiences far and wide. As D.White continues to carve a unique path in the hip-hop world, "8 Ball" stands as a testament to his dedication, authenticity and passion for his craft. “8 Ball” is available to buy/stream now on all platforms: https://ffm.to/8-ball-dwhite.
